title: My heart will trust
lyrics: I'll walk [Dsus/G]closer now on the [D]higher way.
Through the [Am7]darkest night will You [Em7]hold my hand?
O, You [Dsus/G]mourn with me and You [D]dance with me;
For my [Am7]heart of hearts is [Em7]bound to You.
O, You [Dsus/G]counsel me and You [D]comfort me;
When I [Am7]cannot see you [Em7]light my path.
